desc:
🪤 THROW TRAPS FOR ANIMALS 🦁

Bait your trap, throw it, and catch the animals that come running!
🥩 Use food to lure in bigger, rarer animals
💪 Train your strength to throw farther
🐉 Collect animals from tiny frogs to giant dragons
🌈 Find rare mutations like Gold, Diamond and Rainbow
🏆 Become the top trapper on the leaderboards

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more animals!
